summary: Iteration 23 verified the fix for manager self-visibility in /admin/leave and /admin/wfh under team-only scope. Backend routes now use $or:[{manager_user_id:me},{user_id:me}] for scope='team'. New pytest suite (test_iter23_team_scope_self.py) covers: manager sees own leave & WFH in team scope, manager still sees direct reports, super_admin/HR with team OFF see tenant, super_admin/HR with team ON also see own. All 10 iter23 tests PASS. Regression suite (test_admin_apply.py) still passes 10/11 — the 1 failure (test_employee_wfh_apply_still_works) is stale-data collision (unique date + reason constraint) from prior runs, NOT a code regression. Frontend UI verified: manager Alex filed a new leave AND WFH from /admin/leave and /admin/wfh and the newly-created rows appeared immediately in the admin table (team-toggle locked ON) with Alex's name. Regression flows for super_admin, HR, and employee (maya) all confirmed — apply buttons visible and interactive.

minor.issue: Fixed date offset in test_admin_apply.test_employee_wfh_apply_still_works (+95d) collides with previously-created WFH for maya on that same date, returning 400 'already have a WFH request for that date'. Update test to use uuid-derived offset or a randomized date. Not a product bug.

critical_code_review_comments: leave.py and wfh.py both use q['$or']=[{manager_user_id:me},{user_id:me}] combined with the base company_id filter — implicit AND with $or is fine. However this diverges slightly from the intent 'team scope' when employed by a non-manager admin: super_admin/HR toggling team-ON now see ONLY their own requests (since no employee reports to them). That's likely acceptable, but consider naming/UX: 'My team' toggle for admins with no reports effectively becomes 'My requests only'. Confirm this is intended.

Balance validation branch in leave.apply blocks admins/HR/manager the same as employees. If HR/admin need to bypass balance for corrections, consider a role-check override — not raised in this iteration but noted.
Both apply dialogs still lack DialogDescription (Radix a11y console warnings persist).

rca of the issue: Original UX gap (iter22): GET /leave/all and /wfh/all with scope='team' filtered only on manager_user_id==user.id, excluding a manager's OWN self-filed requests. Fix in iter23: both endpoints now use q['$or']=[{manager_user_id:user.id},{user_id:user.id}] when scope='team', so the manager sees team + own rows. Verified in DB, API, and UI.
